title: Verify indicator-type mapping through DHIS2 global metadata settings
problem: Issue #1255 requests remapping indicator types when source and target DHIS2 instances use different definitions. The pinned global-mapping model list omits this type; end-to-end behavior is not yet reproduced.
humanitarian_relevance: MetaData Sync is explicitly recommended in WHO malaria repository guidance. Reliable mapping could reduce integration work, but contribution-specific time savings and deployment are unverified.

evidence.claim: Issue #1255 attributes an indicator-type mapping gap to CHAI/UiO work and says it remained unbuilt in July 2026. No Humanifest acceptance is present.

At the pinned development revision, InstanceMappingPage global.models lists seven model classes and no indicator-type model. This is a static source observation, not a runtime reproduction or proof of every mapping path.

code_surface: At 78c8b8c22278dcbb7d2d5678eaafaa80b0fd0cf9: InstanceMappingPage.tsx global.models, src/models/dhis/mapping.ts global classes, mapping dialog and ApplyMappingUseCase located. Metadata export/import transformation path remains to trace.
proposed_change: First verify whether the existing mapping model can persist and apply indicator-type mappings to outgoing metadata. Only propose a focused extension after original-code reproduction and maintainer confirmation.
research_next_step: Inspect pinned modelFactory and metadata payload transformation for indicatorType references, compare existing mapping PRs #1051/#1251, and audit Vitest setup/hooks before a synthetic original-code reproduction. Do not install or patch until that audit is complete.
tests: No target tests run. Vitest uses jsdom, src/tests/setup.ts and environment loading; inspect these before executing. Seek behavior assertions for mapping persistence and outgoing indicator-type references, with existing mapping controls.
environment: Read-only pinned files in /tmp/humanifest-malaria-integration-screen. No clone, install, build, DHIS2 connection, global configuration change or operational data access.
maintainer: Issue #1255 is open and unassigned with zero comments; inspected timeline has project events and no linked PR. No scope or AI/bot confirmation. No outreach sent or follow-up date invented.
risks: A visible option alone may not make payload rewriting correct. Existing mapping PRs may overlap. Contributor terms, bot eligibility, test side effects, review capacity and real-world benefit remain unresolved.
